title: Kyndryl and Incore Bank collaborate with Google Cloud to help advance agentic AI customer onboarding
summary: Proof of concept demonstrates how agentic AI can accelerate Know Your Customer workflows while supporting explainable, human-governed risk assessment and rating decisions
body_markdown:
**ZURICH, Switzerland, August 31, 2026** —[Kyndryl](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced the successful completion of a cloud-enabled agentic AI proof of concept using[Google’s Gemini models](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) to help[Incore Bank](https://www.incore.ch/en/) accelerate customer onboarding support with a fully automated risk assessment.


For banks, Know Your Customer (KYC) processes are critical to meeting regulatory requirements, managing risk, and delivering a better customer experience. Yet customer onboarding and risk assessment often require teams to gather, verify and reconcile evidence from multiple documents, systems and data sources while maintaining auditable records throughout the customer lifecycle. When these steps rely on manual handoffs, onboarding can slow down, inhibiting the customer experience, while compliance teams spend significant time on repetitive work.


To address these challenges, Incore Bank worked with Kyndryl and[Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/) to demonstrate through a proof of concept how agentic AI can support a more efficient, explainable, fully auditable and human-governed KYC process.


By applying[Kyndryl’s Agentic AI Framework](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/artificial-intelligence/agentic-ai-framework) with Google’s Gemini models and its agentic AI capabilities, the solution introduces a semantic layer with[Kyndryl policy as code capability](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/campaign/policy-as-code) and guardrail agents. This enables end-to-end customer risk assessments across onboarding and ongoing reviews, while continuously monitoring for changes in customer circumstances. The solution brings together multiple AI agents that work across structured and unstructured data, internal systems, and trusted external sources. They support the extraction and validation of customer information, evidence gathering, risk-factor identification, explainable risk scoring, and the creation of auditable decision records for compliance professionals.


“At Incore Bank, we believe innovation must go hand in hand with trust, transparency and strong regulatory governance,” says Mark Dambacher, CEO, Incore Bank. “The proof of concept we completed with Kyndryl and Google Cloud shows how cloud-enabled agentic AI can help banks assess both prospective and existing customers more efficiently while maintaining the rigorous oversight and controls required in a regulated environment. By reducing manual effort and supporting consistent, transparent decision-making, the solution has the potential to strengthen customer risk management across the entire customer lifecycle.”


During the proof of concept, the solution achieved up to 99% accuracy in the automated extraction of data from customer onboarding documentation and demonstrated potential to reduce onboarding time from months to days. In addition, it enabled compliance professionals to spend more time on judgment-intensive cases while maintaining transparency, control and human oversight.


“Agentic AI is the next stage in the evolution of enterprise AI, orchestrating complex business workflows,” said Jacqueline Wild, Managing Director and Vice President, Kyndryl Alps. “In highly regulated industries such as banking, success depends on strong governance, explainability, auditability, secure data access and human oversight. By leveraging Kyndryl’s Agentic AI Framework and policy as code capability, our work with Incore Bank and Google Cloud shows how organizations can modernize critical processes while maintaining the trust, control and regulatory rigor that banking demands.”
